name: OVR Technology
old_description: OVR has unlocked scent for video games with the Omara Scent Display.
about:
OVR Technology is based in Burlington, Vermont, where a multidisciplinary team of industrial designers, fragrance designers, neuroscientists, and software engineers developed the Omara Scent Display, a personal device that brings olfactory immersion to video games.

The company produces two models: the Omara Core, a desktop scent display with ten scent channels priced at $179, and the Omara Pro, a portable advanced display with sixteen channels priced at $649. Both units combine hardware, proprietary scent cartridges or cassettes, and software to deliver scent in burst or continuous modes, with a time-to-perception ranging from 500 to 1,000 milliseconds.

OVR Technology serves the video gaming and virtual reality markets, targeting both end users—gamers seeking deeper immersion—and creators, including independent game studios worldwide that partner with the company to integrate scent into their titles.

The venture was driven by the ambition to add a missing sensory layer to digital experiences, summarized by the company's statement that "gaming has never felt more alive" and its willingness to tackle the difficulty of being first in digital scent technology.

name: OXOS Medical, Inc
old_description: OXOS is transforming medical imaging with innovative, portable X‑ray solutions
about:
OXOS Medical, Inc. was founded in June 2016 in Atlanta, Georgia, as Micro C, LLC, before adopting its current name. The company was started by Evan M. Ruff, a computer engineer and MBA from Georgia Tech, and Dr. Gregory P. Kolovich, a reconstructive hand surgeon trained at Harvard Medical School. Kolovich's frustration with the traditional imaging process during surgery sparked the idea for a portable dynamic digital radiography device.

The company develops and manufactures portable X‑ray systems, including the Micro C and the newer MC2, both cleared by the U.S. FDA under 510(k). The devices are designed for low radiation exposure, modular portability, and a no‑fire positioning system that optimizes alignment. A proprietary software module called AiLARA automates dose optimization per the ALARA principle. The team comprises engineers, designers, and clinical advisors, though headcount and facility size are not disclosed.

OXOS serves orthopedics, pediatrics, and sports medicine, selling directly to clinics, hospitals, and surgical practices. Testimonials cite use by hand and upper‑extremity surgeons, foot‑and‑ankle specialists, and team physicians for professional sports organizations such as the Jacksonville Jaguars. The systems are marketed for point‑of‑need imaging in diverse care settings.

The founders state the mission is to let anyone, anywhere access radiographic diagnostics at the point of need. They emphasize three pillars: safety through low‑dose profiles, simplicity via portable and modular design, and intelligence through real‑time alignment and automated dose control.

Oakwood Industries LLC operates from Memphis, Missouri, producing hardwood furniture for the residential market. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures bedroom, dining, and living room collections from domestic hardwoods. Its product line includes beds, dressers, tables, chairs, and upholstered pieces, all assembled in the United States. Customers can specify custom wood finishes, table-edge profiles, hardware selections, and fabric or leather upholstery through a dealer network. No facility size, employee count, or production volumes are published.

Oakwood sells through a network of independent dealers and distributors, accessible via a locator tool and a dealer login portal on its website. The primary market is residential furniture retailers and interior designers specifying hardwood case goods and upholstery for home environments.

The company highlights domestic manufacturing and a ten-year warranty as its core commitments. Its website positions the brand on American-made quality and long-term durability rather than price or speed, emphasizing configurable options that allow dealers to tailor pieces to client preferences.

name: Obex Packaging
old_description: Obex specializes in Gravure Printing; a high quality process utilized for long print runs.
about:
Obex Packaging, Inc. operates from Reno, Nevada, where it was founded more than two decades ago as a family-owned business. The company entered the printing and film industry with a focus on gravure printing for long-run packaging applications.

The company specializes in rotogravure printing to produce custom packaging, stock packaging, and labels. Its capabilities include die-cut pouches, inside-print security features, anti-tamper labels, and hand-hole cutting for easier handling. Obex serves over 250 brands, ranging from startups to global market leaders, though it does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

Obex’s customer base spans multiple industries, with clients including emerging brands and established multinational companies across various sectors. The firm emphasizes its ability to tailor packaging solutions to exact specifications, whether for custom-branded runs or off-the-shelf stock items.

Obex differentiates itself through a family-business culture that prioritizes strong communication and relationship-building. The company states it strives to exceed expectations by customizing products and shipments to address every client need, describing its approach as “building relationships as strong as our seals.”

name: Oceanside Welding & Fabrication
old_description: Precision aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for homes and businesses.
about:
Oceanside Welding & Fabrication operates from Oakland Park, Florida, serving Broward and Palm Beach counties. The company was started by Jerry Menagh, who brought years of hands-on welding and aluminum fabrication experience to a small local operation that has grown into a family-owned shop.

The shop fabricates custom aluminum railings, gates, and fencing for residential and commercial properties, along with lanai column repair, trailer repair and fabrication, and general custom metal work in aluminum, stainless steel, and mild steel. Projects are handled in-house from design through cutting, welding, and installation, with powder coating coordinated as needed. A CNC plasma cutting capability is slated to come online soon. Both mobile on-site welding and in-shop fabrication are offered.

Customers include homeowners, builders, and property managers throughout South Florida, as well as marine clients needing pontoon repairs and landscaping or pressure-washing businesses requiring custom trailers. The company's work is tailored to withstand the region's coastal climate.

Menagh founded the business on a principle of doing the job right with pride, emphasizing craftsmanship, integrity, reliability, safety, and community. The company highlights transparent quoting, dependable timelines, and a fully welded, powder-coated product built for Florida's environment as key differentiators.

Off The Line Performance operates from Des Moines, Iowa, serving the automotive aftermarket with a focus on Toyota and Subaru performance platforms. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

name: Oh Ghee Inc
old_description: One of the most sacred healing foods with unparalleled therapeutic properties. A superfood for your entire body.
about:
Oh Ghee Inc operates from Bend, Oregon, where it produces a line of ghee-based products for cooking, skincare, and pet care. The company does not publicly state its founding year or ownership structure.

The core product is ghee, a clarified butterfat rendered from organic butter sourced from grass-fed cows. The company processes this ghee into several product categories: culinary ghee for cooking, ghee candles and refills, a skincare line marketed for dry skin and irritation relief, a pet supplement called Dog-Ghee for joint health and digestion, and functional foods that use ghee as a delivery medium for fat-soluble herbs. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

The products target health-conscious consumers seeking nutrient-dense fats, individuals with dry or irritated skin, and pet owners looking for natural supplements. The company positions its ghee as a superfood rich in omega-3 and omega-9 fatty acids, vitamins A, D, E, and K, antioxidants, amino acids, minerals, and enzymes.

Oh Ghee emphasizes the therapeutic properties of ghee, describing it as free of inflammatory properties, highly digestible, and offering superior absorbability for fat-soluble nutrients. The brand was born from a passion for sharing ghee’s healing benefits, though specific founder names or origin stories are not provided.

name: Ohana Fiber Mill
old_description: We make quality fiber from local Hawaiian wool, keeping production close to home and connected to the land. Simple, natural, and made with care.
about:
Ohana Fiber Mill operates in Honokaa on the island of Hawaii. The business was started by Alisha and Chris after they made the Big Island their home, driven by a love for the land and a desire to turn local wool into sustainable fiber. No founding year is publicly disclosed.

The mill provides custom fiber processing for customers who supply their own wool, and it produces 100% Hawaiian-grown and processed yarn. It sources Merino, Romney, and other fibers from Kahua Ranch and other small local producers, handling the full wool-to-skein process in a historic, cozy facility. Handmade items are also sold through an on-site retail store.

The company serves local wool producers, fiber artists, makers, and the broader community. Its customer base includes farmers such as Kahua Ranch, crafters seeking custom processing, and visitors looking for locally made yarn and goods.

Ohana Fiber Mill was founded to keep Hawaii's fiber story alive by building a sustainable network connecting land, animals, and people. The founders emphasize connection to the land and the craft community as their guiding purpose.
